about: Hand-checked opportunities for weekly payouts (spec section 7.7). Every entry comes from the official page at its url, loaded on verified_on. A deadline is set only when that page states one for the current cycle. Re-check each page and update verified_on before every demo; python -m app.core.opportunities shows what a payout would offer. priority ranks entries for payouts (1 is offered first, ahead of any deadline): a scholarship, the spec's example of a payout, comes first.

opportunities.title: MTN Foundation scholarships, including the Top 10 UTME award
opportunities.eligibility: The top 10 UTME scorers, and students in STEM courses at public tertiary institutions in Nigeria; 100 of the 2026 slots are for medical students.

opportunities.title: Interest-free student loan
opportunities.eligibility: Students in Nigerian higher education needing help with institutional fees or upkeep, who do not hold another government-sponsored scholarship. Repayment starts two years after NYSC.

opportunities.title: 2027 UTME registration (dates to be announced)
opportunities.eligibility: Candidates seeking admission into Nigerian tertiary institutions through the 2027 UTME. JAMB says much of registration will start from home, with centre visits only for biometrics.

opportunities.title: Official UTME Biology syllabus (free download)
opportunities.eligibility: Any candidate preparing for the UTME Biology paper.
